[editorial] subtitle 'Soft Luxury' duplicates signatureStyle entry exactly — minor naming redundancy
[general] Subtitle 'Creamy Oriental Warmth' is generic for an Elite product and matches signatureStyle[0] exactly. Recommend a more distinctive hook. No claims issue. Content is otherwise strong.

[general] Subtitle 'Woody Sophistication' is the most generic subtitle in the Wave 1 catalogue — two broad descriptors with no differentiation. This is a premium Elite product. Recommend a more evocative subtitle.
[general] Subtitle 'Sweet Warmth' is generic for a Skye position. Neither word differentiates this fragrance from others. Description and content are excellent. Subtitle alone is low-distinctiveness.

[general] Subtitle 'Aromatic Spice' is the most generic Skye subtitle — both words are category-level descriptors, not product-level identity. Description is strong. Subtitle alone lacks customer hook.

[general] Collection-level observation: 'Clarity' appears in 7 Wave 1 subtitles (Coastal Clarity, Sunlit Clarity, Herbal Clarity, Sea-Kissed Clarity, Leather and Clarity, Radiant Clarity, Clarity in Motion). 'Radiant' appears in 4 Rose subtitles. Founder to decide if any subset requires differentiation.

[general] Description opens 'Lavender and bergamot open onto' — identical construction to libre-flowers-flames-florale ('Lavender and bergamot open into'). Both in Rose collection. Minor monotony risk for customers browsing. Not a blocking issue.

[general] FOUNDER DECISION (R14A): No catalogue-wide subtitle rewrite. 'Radiant Clarity' confirmed. All Clarity/Radiant/Radiance subtitles remain as governed. Shared vocabulary is editorial observation only, not a launch blocker. This issue is closed for Wave 1.
